description: A contemporary retelling where royal life is shaped by media scrutiny, security protocols, and viral rumors—yet the magic persists as a glass-and-stone hidden fortress, an abused set of missing princesses, and a giant, otherworldly bird-bargain that turns a lone young prince into the only one willing to expose a powerful fraud.
tone: Dark, suspenseful modern fairy tale with political pressure, eerie magic, and a hard-won public reckoning.
summary: A young prince rescues twelve missing princesses from a twelve-headed captor, only to race home to unmask the ruthless man trying to steal the credit—and a bride.
